name: ai-annotated-review
description: Open-source workflow for anchored review of long AI-generated documents.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:app && npm run build:adapters
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/annotation-model && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/markdown-block-parser && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/review-core && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/revision-prompt-builder
scripts.build:app: npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/chatgpt-app-web && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/chatgpt-app-server && npm run build:worker-widget && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/chatgpt-app-cloudflare-worker
scripts.build:adapters: npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/browser-extension && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/cli
scripts.build:worker-widget: npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/chatgpt-app-web && npm run build -w @ai-annotated-review/chatgpt-app-server && node scripts/generate-worker-widget.mjs
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/verify-functional-claims.mjs && node scripts/verify-adapters.mjs && npm run smoke:mcp && npm run smoke:ui && npm run verify:worker && npm run verify:license && npm run verify:reality && npm run verify:deployment-config && npm run verify:submission:local
scripts.verify:functionality: npm run build && node scripts/verify-functional-claims.mjs && npm run smoke:mcp && npm run smoke:ui
